title: Clean Disruption - Why Energy & Transportation will be Obsolete by 2030 - Oslo, March 2016
summary: Tony Seba's 2016 keynote argues that batteries, electric vehicles, self-driving cars and solar will converge to disrupt energy and transportation. He predicts by 2030 all new vehicles will be electric and autonomous and that oil and other fossil fuels will be obsolete.
why: Cited as a well-argued case that solar plus batteries and EVs will reach a tipping point sooner than mainstream forecasts expect.

quote.text: the linked reference is a well argued version of the near future of transportation and energy. Highly recommended
